integrity: All claimed nonstandard algebraic reductions, smoothness and explicit examples were checked; published classical theorems are used by name. No independent mathematical review or certification was performed.
scientific_limitations: Finiteness for k >= 5 is non-effective and pointwise in d and k.
The k=4 infinitude criterion requires knowledge of Mordell-Weil rank, not uniformly evaluated here.
No general classification is claimed for arbitrary two-exponent pairs or positivity of r.
title: A genus and elliptic-rank transition for rationally scaled quadratic shifts
